title: Enhancement: Show options for `show ip route`
author: liamkearney-msft
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

the command `show ip route` currently does not show any information on possible command options in its help text:
`
user@sonic-host:~$ show ip route -h
Usage: show ip route [OPTIONS] [IPADDRESS] [vrf <vrf_name>] [...]

  Show IP (IPv4) routing table

Options:
  -d, --display TEXT    all|frontend
  -n, --namespace TEXT  Namespace name or all
  --verbose             Enable verbose output
  -?, -h, --help        Show this message and exit.
`

For example, show ip route summary is an option but no info is in the help text

### Current Behavior

current behaviour shows no info for subcommands

### Proposed Behavior

display subcommands in help text

comments.author: arlakshm
comments.body: @liamkearney-msft, can you add more details on what options are missing?

comments.author: arlakshm
comments.body: @anders-nexthop to triage.

comments.author: liamkearney-msft
anders-nexthop
comments.body:
The underlying issue is that `show ip route` (along with many other show commands) calls into vtysh in order to run commands. This command passes `args` into `bgp_common.show_routes()` which builds a command string and passes it on to vtysh (for example, with args="summary", the internal command will be something like "sudo vtysh -c show ip route summary"). The `click` module handles help menus internally, and it will only know about the top-level options. So not only does the help menu for `show ip route` not have subcommands, but `show ip route summary` doesn't even have a separate help command.

The best solution would probably be to add separate top-level CLI commands for each vtysh command, instead of using `show ip route` as an entry point. But there are lots of nested vtysh commands, so that would be a pretty large undertaking. Alternatively, we can implement a workaround where we intercept the --help argument and make manual call into vtysh to get the list of subcommands, and then print that along with the original help text. That way at least we can give the operator visibility into the available commands, even though the top-level text will not be much help. We can try this out for `show ip route` and if we find a reasonable solution we can use it for other vtysh-based CLI commands as needed.

I've done some basic testing of this approach (handle --help manually by calling into vtysh to get the subcommand list) and it seems like it will work. I will put together a PR for this and submit it for comment.

comments.author: liamkearney-msft
comments.body:
thanks @anders-nexthop - capturing --help and sending it down to vtysh to get the command list sounds like a good approach to me.
appreciate the effort, cheers

linkedPullRequests.title: Issue 24036: Add help for 'show ip route' subcommands
linkedPullRequests.author: anders-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### What I did

Add a new `VtyshCommand` class that extends click CLI commands with vtysh help text and shell completions. The class calls into vtysh to get subcommand information and generates help text following the existing SONiC CLI format.

Closes: [#24036](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/24036)

#### How I did it

Call into vtysh to extract subcommands and descriptions, and use that information to populate help text and completions. A `VtyshCommand` wrapper class handles everything so other commands can easily be extended.

**Update from original submission:** Replaced the old `click._bashcomplete` monkey-patch (removed in Click 8) with Click 8's native shell completion API — a `VtyshParamType` class that implements `shell_complete()` using `CompletionItem`. This is cleaner and forward-compatible.

An important consideration is whether it's acceptable to call into vtysh to retrieve this information. The underlying issue is that the `show ip route` command tree is implemented in FRR, not SONiC. The current CLI is a thin shim. This approach is a general solution that works for any show command passing through to vtysh, and automatically supports new vtysh commands.

Note: This PR does not handle description strings for user-defined arguments (IPADDRESS, vrf NAME, etc). That can be added in a follow-up.

#### How to verify it

Manually verify that subcommand help works, existing help works, tab completions work, and existing commands still function.

comments.body: Thanks @deepak-singhal0408 , I have merged this. This change was for `show ip route` only, but the approach could be used with any vtysh command. Is there desire to extend this feature to other commands? If so I can take that effort up next.

comments.author: deepak-singhal0408
comments.body:
Thanks for the offer @anders-nexthop ! `show ip bgp` seems like another high-value target — the current SONiC CLI `show ip bgp summary` doesn't expose received route counts, and operators frequently need to discover subcommands like `community`, `regexp`, `neighbors <IP> received-routes` that aren't surfaced today.

That said, I'd suggest letting this `show ip route` change soak for a bit first — see how it gets consumed, whether any issues surface, and let feature asks come in organically before expanding scope. Over-exposing vtysh commands could have side effects (users relying on FRR-specific options that change across versions, or discovering commands that interact poorly with SONiC's state model).

cc: @yxieca and @lguohan as well for viz
